subject.title: fix(web-fetch): extract full HTML body content

question: Should title-only Readability recovery preserve the documented configured-provider precedence before local raw body cleanup?
rationale: The code path is mechanically sound, but provider-first recovery can change output, latency, and provider usage for existing configured users, so automation should not decide the product compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Keep provider precedence
options.body: Accept the PR shape because it preserves the documented Readability -> provider -> basic HTML cleanup order while fixing local no-provider/title-only cases.

options.title: Prefer local body first
options.body: Ask for a revised branch where title-only Readability falls back to local body extraction before provider calls, trading compatibility for lower provider cost and more direct body recovery.

options.title: Defer to broader parser work
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the overlapping HTML conversion hardening path to own the whole extraction fallback direction.

recommendation.title: Keep provider precedence
recommendation.body: Accept the PR shape because it preserves the documented Readability -> provider -> basic HTML cleanup order while fixing local no-provider/title-only cases.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects `vincentkoc` most directly to the current provider fallback and readability extraction boundaries.
